photos.c: Above: The start of the Eastleigh 10k on March 19th.  The race included the CAU Inter-Counties Championship and Belgravians were racing in some unfamiliar vests.  In the red vest with white/red shorts towards the left is the eventual race winner Angus Maclean (Team Southampton). 31 is Richard Ward (Belgrave/Surrey), 32 Phil Wicks (Belgrave/Surrey), between and just behind  these latter two is Tim Watson in a white/green vest (Belgrave/Hampshire).  To the right of Phil is Hassan Raidi (Belgrave/Surrey), Jonathan Blackledge (Belgrave), and 15 Jermain Mays (Kent AC/Kent).  Maclean's winning time was 29:47, Mays was second in 30:00 and Phil Wicks 3rd in 30:02.  Belgrave won the team race and Surrey the Inter-County Championship. Full result and report in the previous issue.  Photo by Steve Wicks.
